note: 0.1.15: the meter across a compaction and a prompt sent. `compacted` shows from the compaction until the next main request starts, warm evidence after it (a keep-warm ping that read the cache, prompt_cache moved past it), or the expiry of the cache it leaves, whichever comes first; after that expiry the reading is cold, expired, so an idle session never reads compacted for hours. A main request in flight (the transcript's last main request after the one prompt_cache has the response of, at most 10 minutes old) reads pending (`…`, label `pending`, state unknown, why in-flight) where prompt_cache alone would read cold or the compaction: no cold flash at a prompt. The steps that read the same on 0.1.14 (compacted while alive, warm after the response, warm in flight, the 10-minute bound, the 5-minute tier, a compaction after a request with no response, warm evidence after a compaction, no prompt_cache) pin the edges of both rules.

steps.name: compacted while the cache it leaves is alive (expires_at ahead): `compacted`
the same: --json label compacted, state cold, why compacted
compacted, then idle past the expiry: cold with its age, no longer `compacted`
the same: --json cold, expired, label cold
the same: the plain line reads expired
compacted 3 hours ago, idle since: cold 3h02m, not `compacted` for hours
the same: --json label cold
compacted, transcript only (no prompt_cache), past the expiry: cold ~1h10m
the same: --json cold, expired, source transcript
a prompt sent after the expiry, its request in flight (prompt_cache not yet updated): `…`, not cold
the same: --json unknown, in-flight, label pending, no expiry; last is the request in flight
the same: the plain line `cache request pending`
the same, --short: `c …`
the same, --color always: no colour
after a compaction, a prompt sent while the old expiry is ahead: `…`, not the old cache's age
the same: --json label pending
after a compaction, a prompt sent after the old expiry: `…`, not cold
the request's response in (prompt_cache from it): warm, 0m
the same: --json warm
a prompt sent while prompt_cache reads warm: the request reads that cache, still warm 30m
a request started 11 minutes ago with no response recorded (failed or stopped): back to cold
the same: --json cold, expired
a request started exactly 10 minutes ago: still pending
the 5-minute tier, its last request done and expired 100 s ago: cold, not pending
a compaction after the transcript's last request (whose response never came): `compacted`
a keep-warm ping that read the cache after the compaction: warm
the same: --json warm, last a keep-warm ping
prompt_cache moved past the compaction (no transcript): warm
no prompt_cache (after a resume), the transcript's request after the compaction: warm ~0m, not pending
a compaction before the request prompt_cache has the response of, a later request sent: warm, not pending
the same: --json warm
the transcript's request 3 s after prompt_cache's start (inside the 5 s margin): the same request, cold
the transcript's request 6 s after prompt_cache's start (past the 5 s margin): a later request, pending
a transcript request an hour in the future (a skewed clock): not pending, cold
